name: landinglab
description: LandingLab — clonar/gerar landing pages, editor, domínios e storefront multi-domínio

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,backoffice,storefront -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "pnpm --filter @blackshop/api dev" "pnpm --filter @blackshop/worker dev" "pnpm --filter @blackshop/backoffice dev" "pnpm --filter @blackshop/landinglab-storefront dev"
scripts.build:libs: pnpm --filter @blackshop/landinglab-adapters build && pnpm --filter @blackshop/landinglab-cloner build && pnpm --filter @blackshop/landinglab-render build && pnpm --filter @blackshop/landinglab-build build:html-builder
